exposure: Thromboprophylaxis with low molecular weight heparin (LMWH)
outcome: Thromboprophylaxis with low molecular weight heparin (LMWH)
finding: While almost 80% of pregnant women admitted to hospital were on the correct thromboprophylaxis strategy, 49% were under-dosed, and the odds of receiving appropriate thromboprophylaxis were significantly increased if the woman was >35 years or with parity>3.
mod_finding: The study found that women with higher parity (greater than 3) had significantly increased odds of receiving appropriate thromboprophylaxis.
